title: AEM Experimentation Plugin Setup
description: Install and configure the AEM Experimentation plugin for content experimentation, A/B testing, and audience targeting.

tasks.title: Review plugin files and understand structure
tasks.description:
Review the plugin files installed under plugins/experimentation/.

1. Examine src/index.js to understand exported functions: loadEager() and configuration options
2. Read instructions.md for full integration requirements and usage patterns
3. Identify any dependencies or prerequisites for integration
4. Document the expected configuration object structure

tasks.title: Create scripts/experiment-loader.js
tasks.description:
Create a new file scripts/experiment-loader.js that handles experimentation detection and eager loading.

1. Add isExperimentationEnabled() function that checks for experimentation metadata via DOM queries:
   - meta tags: [name^="experiment"], [name^="campaign-"], [name^="audience-"], [property^="campaign:"], [property^="audience:"]
   - section-metadata divs containing Experiment, Campaign, or Audience text
2. Add exported runExperimentation(document, config) async function that:
   - Returns null early if experimentation is not enabled, but sets up a message listener for 'hlx:experimentation-get-config' to respond with empty config
   - If enabled, dynamically imports loadEager from '../plugins/experimentation/src/index.js'
   - Calls and returns loadEager(document, config)
   - Wraps import in try/catch, logging errors to console
3. Follow the exact code structure from the v2 README

tasks.title: Add experimentation config and import to scripts.js
tasks.description:
Add experimentation configuration and experiment loader import to scripts/scripts.js.

1. Add import at the top of the file:
   import { runExperimentation } from './experiment-loader.js';
2. Add experimentationConfig object after imports with:
   - prodHost: placeholder value (to be configured by user)
   - audiences: object with mobile and desktop functions as defaults
3. Do NOT add a pluginContext object — v2 does not use one
4. Do NOT add getAllMetadata or other helper functions — v2 detection is handled in experiment-loader.js

tasks.title: Integrate runExperimentation into loadEager function
tasks.description:
Add the experiment loader call into the loadEager() function in scripts/scripts.js.

1. Add 'await runExperimentation(doc, experimentationConfig);' early in loadEager()
2. Place it after existing early setup (decorateTemplatesAndThemes, etc.) but before loadHeader, loadFooter, and decorateBlocks calls
3. This timing is critical — the plugin must run before LCP because it may swap page content
4. This single call handles all experimentation detection and variant application
5. There is NO separate loadLazy call needed in v2 — do not add one

tasks.title: Add modulepreload to head.html
tasks.description:
Add a modulepreload link hint for the experiment loader in head.html.

1. Add: <link rel="modulepreload" href="/scripts/experiment-loader.js" />
2. Place it alongside existing modulepreload links (typically after the scripts/scripts.js preload)
3. This tells the browser to start fetching the module early, reducing latency when the eager phase imports it
4. Note: preload experiment-loader.js, NOT plugins/experimentation/src/index.js directly

tasks.title: Configure production hostname
tasks.description:
Set the experimentationConfig.prodHost value in scripts/scripts.js to match your production domain.

1. Update prodHost to your production domain (e.g., 'www.mysite.com')
2. This controls overlay visibility — debug pill is hidden on prod, shown on non-prod origins
3. Alternative: Set isProd as a custom function if you have complex production detection logic:
   isProd: () => !window.location.hostname.endsWith('hlx.page') && window.location.hostname !== 'localhost'
4. Test that overlay appears on localhost/preview but not on the production domain

tasks.title: Define audience targeting functions
tasks.description:
Add custom audience functions to experimentationConfig.audiences for targeted experiments.

1. Each audience is a named function returning a boolean
2. Default audiences (mobile/desktop) are already included in the config template
3. Add project-specific audiences as needed, e.g.:
   - 'new-visitor': () => !localStorage.getItem('returning')
   - us: async () => { const resp = await fetch('/geo-api'); const geo = await resp.json(); return geo.country === 'US'; }
4. Keys must be kebab-case and match audience names used in page metadata
5. Audiences are referenced in metadata with: Experiment Audience: mobile

tasks.title: Add RUM sampling configuration for experiment pages
tasks.description:
Add RUM sampling rate override in head.html for experiment pages.

1. Add inline <script> block BEFORE the aem.js script load in head.html
2. Script should set window.RUM_SAMPLING_RATE using the same detection logic as experiment-loader.js:
   - Check meta tags: [name^="experiment"], [name^="campaign-"], [name^="audience-"]
   - Check section-metadata divs for Experiment/Campaign/Audience text
   - If detected: set rate to 10 (1-in-10), otherwise 100 (1-in-100)
3. Verify aem.js has the line: const weight = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('rum') === 'on' ? 1 : defaultSamplingRate;
4. If that line is missing, apply changes from https://github.com/adobe/helix-rum-js/pull/159/files

tasks.title: Configure advanced options (optional)
tasks.description:
Review and configure optional plugin settings in experimentationConfig as needed.

1. storage: Custom storage backend (default: window.sessionStorage, use window.localStorage for cross-session persistence)
2. decorationFunction: Custom DOM redecoration function for fragment experiments, e.g.:
   decorationFunction: (el) => { buildBlock(el); decorateBlock(el); }
3. Meta tag prefixes (if custom naming needed):
   - audiencesMetaTagPrefix
   - campaignsMetaTagPrefix
   - experimentsMetaTagPrefix
4. Query parameter customization:
   - audiencesQueryParameter
   - campaignsQueryParameter
   - experimentsQueryParameter

tasks.title: Configure consent management (optional)
tasks.description:
Integrate consent management platform (CMP) with experimentation if required.

1. Import updateUserConsent and isUserConsentGiven from '../plugins/experimentation/src/index.js'
2. Add consent initialization in experiment-loader.js (recommended) or scripts.js:
   - OneTrust: Bridge OptanonWrapper callback to dispatch custom event, check for C0003/C0004 groups
   - Cookiebot: Listen for CookiebotOnConsentReady and CookiebotOnAccept events
   - Custom: Listen for consent-updated custom event
3. Call updateUserConsent(true/false) in your CMP callback
4. Add metadata to experiments requiring consent: Experiment Requires Consent: true
5. Initialize consent BEFORE calling loadEager in experiment-loader.js

tasks.title: Commit instrumentation changes
tasks.description:
Stage and commit all plugin instrumentation changes to the feature branch.

1. Stage modified/new files: scripts/experiment-loader.js, scripts/scripts.js, head.html
2. Commit with message: "Instrument AEM Experimentation plugin"
3. Push to the plugin/aem-experimentation branch
4. Ensure all changes follow project coding conventions

tasks.title: Review and merge plugin branch
tasks.description:
Review all changes and merge the plugin branch into the default branch.

1. Review all changes on the plugin/aem-experimentation branch
2. Create a pull request to merge into the default branch (main)
3. Verify code quality and integration completeness
4. After merging, verify the experimentation debug overlay pill:
   - Appears on localhost and non-prod preview URLs
   - Is hidden on the production domain
5. Check browser console for any errors during plugin initialization

tasks.title: Create and test first experiment
tasks.description:
Set up and validate a test experiment to confirm the integration works correctly.

1. Add experiment metadata to a content page:
   - Experiment: (experiment name/ID)
   - Experiment Variants: (comma-separated URLs to variant pages)
   - Experiment Split: (optional traffic percentages, e.g., '50/50')
2. Preview the page on a non-prod URL
3. Verify:
   - Experiment activates correctly
   - Variant pages load as expected
   - Debug overlay shows active experiment details
   - RUM events are being captured
4. Test variant switching using query parameters if supported
